name: Maple-Dijon Chicken Drumsticks with Lemony Dill, Kale & Cabbage Slaw
instructions: Place oil, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a large baking dish; whisk to combine the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the baking dish with the marinade, and turn to coat.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until chicken is cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise. Add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage the greens with the dressing until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide chicken and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
